explanation: Reviewed frozen native head 1aa1d5ddaea2f2f1d34a19e0743658c0ed2e26a2, canonical diff SHA-256 8d89666983097cb6032e7f5a4314ab98b83f144a12dd6f953ea2e53f19214de1. Source review found compile blockers and concrete integration defects; Main's actual build failure is recorded in artifact://406. No edits or validation commands were run by this reviewer; runtime/pixel approval remains outstanding.

findings.title: Restore the feed repository's synchronization primitive
findings.body: The patch deletes MockFeedRepository.lock while eleven methods still call lock.lock()/unlock(). This class remains in the application Sources phase, so fixture and production configurations fail to compile; Main's build-for-testing output in artifact://406 confirms these errors. Restore the synchronization primitive rather than removing protection from this @unchecked Sendable repository.

findings.title: Use defined spacing tokens throughout the new views
findings.body: The tab bar references AppSpacing.space6, but AppSpacing defines neither space6 nor the new space2/space10 references used in SessionPostCard, ActivityViews, ExploreViews, and ProfileViews. Main's build output confirms the RootView error; the other unresolved members are present in the frozen source. Replace these references with existing tokens or define the intended tokens.

findings.title: Migrate the remaining Home tab consumer to Feed
findings.body: AppTab.home is removed here, but HomeFeedView's onChange handler still compares the selected tab with .home at HomeFeedView.swift:108. No remaining alias or extension provides that member, so the application cannot compile. Change the consumer to .feed so returning from publishing or following also runs the intended feed refresh.

findings.title: Use the stored post ID after making the initial post optional
findings.body: The new post-ID initializer makes item optional and sets it to nil for Activity navigation, but toggleLike still passes item.id to the repository at line 76. Accessing that member without unwrapping is a compile error; force-unwrapping would crash the new Activity path. Use the nonoptional postID stored by both initializers.

findings.title: Make RPC parameter conformances safe for Supabase's Sendable API
findings.body: With SWIFT_DEFAULT_ACTOR_ISOLATION=MainActor, the new local ExploreParams and FeedParams Encodable conformances are main-actor isolated, while SupabaseClient.rpc requires Sendable parameters. Main's actual build reports both calls as errors in artifact://406. Apply the existing nonisolated Sendable payload pattern used by FeedParameters to these parameters and the corresponding new community RPC payloads.

findings.title: Migrate all test repositories to the expanded protocols
findings.body: FailingLikeFeedRepository, RecordingDraftFeedRepository, and UserAwareFeedRepository retain the three-argument fetchFeed and omit fetchPost/toggleBookmark; MissingProfileFailingCreateRepository omits the four new ProfileRepository requirements. BoardedTests cannot conform to the expanded protocols. The default five-argument fetchFeed also recursively calls itself for any conformer relying on it instead of implementing the new witness. Update every test double while preserving the rollback, account-switch, and publication tests.

findings.title: Declare the Activity test's actor, post, and clock values
findings.body: testActivityUnreadStateAndMarkAsRead uses otherID, postID, and now without declaring them. Those names exist only in unrelated local scopes or as qualified UITestFixtures members. This prevents BoardedTests from compiling even after repository conformances are migrated. Declare deterministic local values or qualify the fixture members.

findings.title: Insert route ownership using the actual routes table column
findings.body: Create Route sends author_id to routes, but the table stores ownership as user_id; author_id belongs to the CommunityRoute RPC projection. Existing insert RLS also checks auth.uid() = user_id. Consequently real route creation fails while the mock succeeds. Encode user_id in the insert and map the returned table row into the community projection, including its selected venue.

findings.title: Preserve following-only filtering on subsequent feed pages
findings.body: Initial load now requests followingOnly=true, but loadMore still calls the three-argument form, whose new default is false. Scrolling past the first page therefore returns older posts by unfollowed authors and mixes discovery into the Following feed. Pass the same followingOnly and postFilter arguments on every page.

findings.title: Initialize deep-linked reaction state from the fetched post
findings.body: Activity opens the postID initializer, initializing likeCount to zero and isLiked to false. After fetchPost completes, currentPost overwrites the server values with those defaults, and no load handler initializes the local reaction state. Posts with existing kudos appear unliked with zero kudos, and tapping an already-liked post can remove the server like while showing an incorrect count. Initialize reaction state after loading or keep it in the loaded model.

findings.title: Derive Feed bookmark state from the linked route projection
findings.body: The frozen get_session_feed contract supplies bookmark state as route.is_saved, but SessionFeedItem looks separately for a top-level is_saved and defaults to false. A valid response containing a saved route therefore displays an empty bookmark after reload; tapping what appears to be Save removes the existing bookmark. Use the linked route's isSaved as the source of truth and keep mutations consistent with it.

findings.title: Wire public-profile post actions to mutations and navigation
findings.body: PublicProfileView renders SessionPostCard with default arguments, leaving onLike and onBookmark as empty closures, and provides no NavigationLink to post/comment detail. Its public session cards therefore expose enabled kudos/bookmark controls that do nothing and comment counts that cannot open the thread. Supply authenticated handlers, bind their results, and provide a real post-detail destination.

findings.title: Provide a detail bookmark handler and omit invalid targets
findings.body: The new bookmark is always enabled, but SessionPostDetailView supplies only onLike, so every detail-page bookmark uses an empty closure. Feed also renders it for manually logged posts without a linked route, where the handler simply returns. Require a real action for linked routes and hide or disable the control when no accessible route exists.

findings.title: Connect Feed authors and routes to their destinations
findings.body: Feed now carries author.id and CommunityRoute, but author and featured-route text remain plain content inside the single post-detail NavigationLink. Tapping them cannot open PublicProfileView or RouteDetailView; route-detail callers exist only in Explore and Saved Routes. Add distinct controls so Feed → route inspection → prefilled Log and Feed → author profile are reachable.

findings.title: Populate the Activity badge from real unread state
findings.body: AppNavigation initializes unreadActivityCount to 2 for every production launch, and no code assigns it again. ActivityViewModel loads and clears a separate unreadCount, so guests and users with empty inboxes see a fabricated unread badge and Read All never clears the tab or Feed-header badge. Synchronize the shared badge with the authenticated inbox and successful read mutations.

findings.title: Roll back Activity read state when persistence fails
findings.body: markRead and markAllRead clear local unread state before persistence, then discard errors with try?. Network or authorization failures leave the UI claiming success while the server remains unread, and markRead's guard prevents retrying until reload. Surface failures and restore prior timestamps/counts, or commit local state only after success.

findings.title: Expose cursor pagination for the Activity inbox
findings.body: Activity requests only the newest 50 events with nil cursors and has no continuation state or load-more control. Older notifications and their destinations become unreachable even though unreadCount counts the entire inbox. Retain the final createdAt/id cursor and page through get_activity with stable equal-timestamp handling.

findings.title: Page through saved routes instead of silently truncating them
findings.body: Explore requests only the first 40 routes with nil cursors, including Saved, and its view provides no continuation control. Profile independently stops at 50 saved routes. Users exceeding these limits cannot browse their complete saved collection despite the RPC's stable cursor contract. Preserve and consume the createdAt/id cursor for these collections.

findings.title: Request authentication before follow and bookmark mutations
findings.body: Explore's follow/bookmark handlers call authenticated repositories without checking boardedAuth; PublicProfileView Follow and Feed's new bookmark path do the same. Guests get repository errors rather than sign-in, and Feed hides that error while posts exist. Apply the established auth.requestAuthentication() gate before these mutations.

findings.title: Reserve bottom safe-area space for the replacement tab bar
findings.body: The system tab bar is hidden and customTabBar overlays the TabView in a ZStack without a content inset. Profile's final Sign Out and the active logger's End Session retain only 20 points of bottom padding while the bar occupies 58 points plus the raised Log control, covering and intercepting their content rather than letting it scroll fully above navigation. Install the bar using a real bottom safe-area inset.

findings.title: Preserve Dynamic Type and selected-state accessibility in tabs
findings.body: The replacement buttons fix every label at 10 points and communicate selection only through color/weight. No tab, including Log, receives a selected accessibility trait, and the fixed-height bar does not scale with text category. Use scalable text with an accommodating layout and announce selection so larger-text and VoiceOver users retain usable navigation.

findings.title: Keep unknown prefilled grades unknown until explicitly chosen
findings.body: A CommunityRoute with null gradeLabel receives V0 regardless of grade system. YDS or Font routes consequently have a selection absent from the picker, yet Save Attempt writes the fabricated label into the session and published result. Initialize an explicit ungraded state, require a valid choice where attempts require a grade, and support custom labels without an empty picker.

findings.title: Validate session-context bounds before queuing an uneditable session
findings.body: Conditions and Private Notes accept arbitrary lengths, while the frozen server limits are 500 and 1000 characters. Longer input creates a local session whose upsert fails on every replay; SessionSyncService then blocks its attempts and publication. No view calls updateSession, so users cannot repair the queued context. Validate before starting and expose correction for failed context.

findings.title: Allow unknown terrain instead of publishing an invented value
findings.body: Terrain starts as vertical and has no unspecified option, so saving after entering only a route name asserts a physical fact the creator never supplied. Users who do not know the terrain cannot preserve null as required by the catalog contract. Make terrain optional and provide an explicit Unspecified entry.

findings.title: Clear the link when changing a prefilled attempt to a manual route
findings.body: OutcomeSheet stores the prefilled route ID once but allows freely editing the route name without clearing that ID. Replacing the suggestion with a different climb persists the new name against the original catalog route, causing publication to expose the wrong route facts/bookmark target. Make linked identity immutable or explicitly clear it when switching to a manual climb.

findings.title: Back the new Sessions tab with private session history
findings.body: Profile's new Sessions selection renders ownPosts, populated only by get_session_feed. Finished but unpublished sessions yield an empty journal despite nonzero private statistics, with no way to reopen their conditions/notes or attempts; Log's Session history is also only a heading. Load the owner's private sessions/attempts separately from published posts rather than requiring publication to review private history.

findings.title: Keep fixture relationships and bookmarks consistent across repositories
findings.body: The fixture maintains independent bookmark/follow stores in MockFeedRepository, MockCommunityRepository, and MockProfileRepository, while Profile's savedRoutes is fixed. Saving in Feed never appears in Explore/Profile, following in Explore does not change Feed/public profile, and removing a Profile bookmark reloads the same row. Share coherent backing state or propagate mutations so full-journey captures exercise consistent behavior.

findings.title: Make the approved Feed fixture survive repository sorting
findings.body: Jordan receives createdAt=now and Maya now-7200, while MockFeedRepository sorts descending. The initial Feed therefore starts with Jordan and shows Maya next, opposite the frozen capture contract. Relative times also use the real clock rather than the frozen capture clock. Preserve approved fixture ordering/display-time semantics through the repository and inject the frozen time reference without changing production pagination.
